memoryBuilder.verseText: Joseph said: 'Do not be afraid. I will look after you.'

sequence.prompt: How did God save the promise family? Put it in order.

items.label: The king put Joseph in charge
Joseph stored up mountains of grain
His brothers came to buy food
Joseph forgave them and hugged them

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Put Joseph in charge of the land
Wept, forgave them and fed them

application.question: Joseph forgave the people who hurt him most. Who is hardest for you to forgive?
application.followUp: Joseph did not pretend it never happened — he said out loud what they had done, and forgave them anyway. That is what Jesus does for us.
